# Vertex wobble

Makes surfaces breathe and wobble: vertices move along their normals by slowly drifting noise, and the normals are recomputed so lighting follows the new shape. Needs a reasonably dense mesh. It holds still when motion is off.

<EffectDemo effect="wobble" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { wobble } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/wobble';

const effect = wobble({ preset: 'jelly' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
  effect.tick(clock.getDelta());
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.amplitude = 0.08`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter          | Type    | Default | Range             | Description                                             |
| ------------------ | ------- | ------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `amplitude`        | number  | `0.08`  | 0 – 1 scene units | How far vertices move; 0 turns it off.                  |
| `frequency`        | number  | `2`     | 0.1 – 20          | Size of the bulges: higher values make smaller ones.    |
| `speed`            | number  | `0.4`   | 0 – 4             | How fast the bulges drift.                              |
| `recomputeNormals` | boolean | `true`  |                   | Light the displaced shape rather than the original one. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                          |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `jelly`     | `amplitude: 0.12`, `frequency: 1.2`, `speed: 0.8` |
| `breathing` | `amplitude: 0.05`, `frequency: 0.6`, `speed: 0.3` |
| `boiling`   | `amplitude: 0.04`, `frequency: 6`, `speed: 1.5`   |

Apply one with `wobble({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Materials · tracked as story X12.8 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `effect.setMotion(false)`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 7.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/wobble`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Simplex-noise displacement along normals with normals rebuilt from displaced tangent neighbors.
